kurz: Good colour means something different depending on the food: a golden-brown crust, a bright green or a deep red.
bild_im_kopf: Three paint boxes: brown comes from heat and dryness, green from short cooking, red from acid.
bedeutung: Brown comes from the [[maillard-reaktion|Maillard reaction]] and [[karamellisierung|caramelisation]] in dry heat. Green survives a short cooking time. Red pigments need acid.
was_passiert: Colour is a good clue to flavour: golden brown means roasted aromas, bright green means fresh and crisp.
faustregeln: For green: short, then refresh in cold water.
